name: Turn without drifting
description: Rotate the nose while keeping a steady position and height.

steps.text: Use Angle mode. Yaw turns the nose. After a turn, pitch and roll follow the new direction; the controls have not reversed.
steps.title: Understand yaw and orientation

steps.text: Hover in the marker and face the original takeoff direction.
steps.title: Face the takeoff direction

steps.text: Yaw right by a quarter turn while staying inside the marker. Release yaw when facing the new direction.
steps.title: Turn right without drifting

steps.text: Yaw back to the original direction and stop drifting.
steps.title: Turn back and settle

steps.text: Return to the start marker. Level the drone, lower throttle gently and hold a stopped landing for two seconds.
steps.title: Land at the start
